# Guardian Naga (`monsters:guardian-naga`)
*Large celestial, lawful good* | **CR** 10 (XP 5,900; PB +4)
**AC** 18 | **HP** 136 (16d10 + 48) | **Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
**STR** 19 (+4) | **DEX** 18 (+4) | **CON** 16 (+3) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 19 (+4) | **CHA** 18 (+4)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +8, [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md) +7, [Saving Throw: INT](../proficiencies/saving-throw-int.md) +7, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +8, [Saving Throw: CHA](../proficiencies/saving-throw-cha.md) +8
**Skills:** [Skill: Arcana](../proficiencies/skill-arcana.md) +11, [Skill: History](../proficiencies/skill-history.md) +11, [Skill: Religion](../proficiencies/skill-religion.md) +11
**Damage Immunities:** poison
**Condition Immunities:** [Charmed](../conditions/charmed.md), [Paralyzed](../conditions/paralyzed.md), [Poisoned](../conditions/poisoned.md), [Restrained](../conditions/restrained.md)
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14
**Languages:** Celestial, Common

## Traits
- **Celestial Restoration.** If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.
- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.
- **Poisonous Spittle.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.
- **Spellcasting.** The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
  - At will: [Thaumaturgy](../spells/thaumaturgy.md)
  - 1/day: [Clairvoyance](../spells/clairvoyance.md) (level 3), [Cure Wounds](../spells/cure-wounds.md) (level 6), [Flame Strike](../spells/flame-strike.md) (level 6), [Geas](../spells/geas.md) (level 5), [True Seeing](../spells/true-seeing.md) (level 6)
